findings.statement: Within the directly reviewed pp.4, 6, and 7, 带官星印绶 appears twice on p.7: once with 年为本 and once with 月为提纲. Neither sentence identifies visible heavenly stems, hidden stems, month-branch content, or whole-chart scope.

The p.6 passage presents 官/杀 as paired labels under its 官 category and 印绶/倒食 as paired labels under 生气; p.4 separately associates 辛 with 偏官/七杀, 壬 with 印绶, and 癸 with 倒食/偏印. The p.7 candidate does not select one member of either pair.

The p.7 sentences about year inheritance, hour conduct, auspicious or inauspicious spirits, and 月令有用神/父母力 are separate prose branches; none defines the operand layer or polarity of the candidate phrase.

The same-region text supplies label context but does not close a predicate for 带 scope or for whether 官星/印綬 include 七杀/倒食/偏印; a direct visible/hidden-field predicate would require an unstated convention.

claims.statement: The same-source pp.4, 6, and 7 context does not define a directly executable 带官星印綬 predicate over current tenGods.visible/hidden fields.
The candidate is ready to apply as a historical temperament rule after this bounded recheck.

unknowns.statement: The source does not define whether 带 operates on surface stems, hidden stems, the month pillar, or the complete natal chart.
The source does not state whether 官星 means only 正官 or includes 七杀/偏官, nor whether 印綬 means only 正印 or includes 倒食/偏印 in this sentence.
Historical edition, transmission lineage, and independent corroboration for this exact phrase remain unresolved.
